description: This PHP file defines an API endpoint class 'EmployeeTimeAtWorkAPI' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for retrieving employee time at work data for the dashboard widget. It includes methods for handling GET requests to fetch work time details, validation rules, and integrates various traits and dependencies for processing date/time and employee data.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkAPI
classes.description: API class providing an endpoint to retrieve employee work time data for dashboard widgets.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current employee's time at work data, considering optional date/time and timezone offset parameters, and returns the structured response with work time and metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getOne' method's request parameters.
